records.title: VP Operations
records.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions. 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence. 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance. 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but not limited to the following.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support.
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact.
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements.
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability.
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations.
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements.
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives.
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies.
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: **Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring.**

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions.
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation.
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant.
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365.
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste.
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills.
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
***Ready to lead a function, not just a shift? This is your next step.***

American Armor Gloves makes high-quality nitrile gloves here at home in South Carolina. Healthcare workers, first responders, and essential workers across the country rely on what we build. Our purpose is simple: **We strengthen America by building quality protection at home.**

We're a lean, growing manufacturer scaling toward 320–350 people, and we've spent the past year building the foundation for that growth: a redesigned organization, a clear vision with quarterly milestones, defined leadership roles, and a new leadership and compensation architecture. Manufacturing is the heart of that growth, and we need a leader ready to own it.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Director of Manufacturing is one of the most essential roles in our company. You'll own the end-to-end performance of our Manufacturing department, turning business plans into consistent, safe, high-quality production results.

This role is built for an accomplished Manufacturing Manager who is ready to take the next step. You've proven you can run a strong operation. Now you're ready to **lead through systems and leaders rather than personal effort on the floor**, and to build a manufacturing function that performs at a high level no matter which team is on shift.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, you'll be the bridge between enterprise strategy and shift-by-shift execution. You'll set the systems, build the leaders, and own the results.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own manufacturing performance.** Deliver results across safety, quality, OEE, throughput, schedule attainment, labor productivity, scrap, and downtime through accountable leaders and strong systems.

* **Build repeatable production systems.** Design shift handoffs, accountability routines, labor deployment standards, and scheduling so performance never depends on heroics.

* **Lead and develop your Shift Manager team.** Coach your Shift Managers as leaders, not only as production operators, and build the next generation of manufacturing leadership.

* **Integrate compounding and batching.** Keep material availability, formulation compliance, and production demand aligned and well governed.

* **Drive continuous improvement.** Lead projects that reduce waste, improve workflow, raise OEE, and close performance gaps, in partnership with Process Engineering.

* **Partner across the business.** Work side by side with Quality, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, and People & Culture to remove barriers to production.

* **Build workforce capability.** Own training plans, manufacturing career pathways, and engagement so our workforce is ready to support growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

You'll set daily and weekly production priorities, deploy labor across shifts, manage Shift Manager performance, and direct improvement projects within manufacturing. You'll shape manufacturing KPI targets, capacity planning, equipment needs, and staffing structure through your recommendations to the VP of Operations. You'll lead Shift Managers, Production Planning, and Batching/Compounding leadership, with a frontline team of Production Supervisors and Manufacturing Associates across multiple shifts.

**A REAL CAREER PATHWAY**

We grow leaders deliberately, and this role is designed as a launch point, not a ceiling. Our leadership framework defines exactly what it takes to grow from functional leadership into executive leadership, and we invest in getting high performers there.

* **Where you go next.** The Director of Manufacturing is a direct pathway to VP of Operations or other senior operations leadership, based on demonstrated enterprise judgment, cross-functional partnership, and the strength of the leadership bench you build.

* **How you get there.** Expect direct mentoring from the VP of Operations, exposure to enterprise planning and capital decisions, cross-functional visibility, and formal leadership development.

* **A clear standard.** Your growth is measured against the same competency framework used for job descriptions, performance reviews, and succession planning, so you always know where you stand and what comes next.

* **Visibility at the top.** Our annual bench-strength review puts strong leaders on the executive team’s radar early.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

* **Essential to the mission.** Every glove we ship runs through the function you lead.

* **Build, not just run.** Our organization is lean and still forming, so you'll shape systems and standards that scale with the business.

* **A clear operating rhythm.** A shared vision, quarterly milestones, and a common scorecard keep leaders aligned and connect your work to company priorities.

* **Leave a legacy.** You'll develop Shift Managers into future Directors and Supervisors into future Shift Managers, building a team that carries the company forward.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent progressive leadership experience

* 8–10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership in a high-volume environment

* Proven success leading multiple shifts and developing frontline leaders

* A track record of owning department performance through KPIs, systems, and accountable leadership

* Strong cross-functional partnership with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and HR

* Solid knowledge of OSHA safety requirements and manufacturing quality systems

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, ERP/MRP systems (NetSuite preferred), KPI dashboards, production scheduling, and QMS

**Bonus points for:** experience in medical device, PPE, chemical processing, or FDA-regulated manufacturing; Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement practice; ERP implementation; and leading through growth and scale.

**HOW YOU LEAD**

You lead safely, every shift, not only when incidents happen. You hold leaders accountable through systems, not by stepping in for them. When something breaks, you fix the system, not just the shift. You raise problems early and directly. You treat Quality, Engineering, and Maintenance as partners, and you understand how manufacturing affects the entire business.

**READY FOR YOUR NEXT STEP?**

If you're a Manufacturing Manager ready to own a function, build leaders, and grow into enterprise leadership with a company that's scaling with purpose, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

*American Armor Gloves is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, mental or physical disability of a qualified individual, veteran or military status, pregnancy, marital status, familial status, genetic information, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local law.*

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean

postedPay.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean

records.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.

The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Required Qualifications: 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

Preferred Qualifications: 

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

Position Success Criteria: 

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Advanced Mission Partners, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Science Systems and Applications, Inc (SSAI) seeks a Director of Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, and engineering services operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, optimizing manufacturing performance, managing resources, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products and engineering services. This position will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, improving profitability, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the company's continued growth. 
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aerospace and defense manufacturing, demonstrated leadership experience, and a proven ability to manage complex manufacturing operations while meeting demanding quality, cost, and delivery requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree (BS) in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in program management, project management, manufacturing operations, or engineering.
* At least 5 years of experience managing complex technical or manufacturing programs, preferably within the aerospace, defense, or electronics manufacturing industries.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations, managing budgets, and improving operational performance.
* Experience working with aerospace and defense customers, including government agencies, prime contractors, and commercial aerospace organizations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, engineering development, quality assurance, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and implementing operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing services (EMS), or precision manufacturing.
* Familiarity with printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), electronic systems integration, and aerospace manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
* Experience with government contracts, including FAR, DFARS, ITAR, and EAR requirements.
* Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM), program financial forecasting, and cost control methodologies.
* Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and project management software, such as Microsoft Project or equivalent tools.
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), production transitions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation, process optimization, and production scalability.

**EOE, including disability/vets**

***Physical Requirements:*** *While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and use hands to touch, handle or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk and hear and occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.*

records.title: Manufacturing Operations Director
records.description:
LISI AEROSPACE is ranked 60th in the global aerospace value chain and specializes in the design and manufacture of high-tech metal components to enhance aircraft safety and performance. Active since 1950 in the fastener market (no. 3 worldwide), LISI AEROSPACE has been a recognized player in metal components for aircraft engines and airframes since 2011. With its dedication to industrial excellence, LISI AEROSPACE aims to become a leader in costs, quality, deadlines and workplace safety. This mindset is represented at every level of our company and by all of our team members. At LISI AEROSPACE, we focus above all on advancement and flexibility. Every employee is empowered and has the latitude they need to carry out their assignments and develop their skills. We provide this mobility and training through our Corporate University, the LISI Knowledge Institute (LKI). As a result, our company is growing fast and always welcoming new talents.
 
 
**COMPENSATION:** $160,000.00 - $200,000.00 annually
 
 
**SCHEDULE:** 4/9 + 4
 
 
SUMMARY
 
The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for production, delivery and quality of highly engineered aerospace fasteners, utilizing machining, forging, thermal treatment and coating operations. In addition to these responsibilities, the Director of Manufacturing will also be responsible for safety, environmental results, efficiencies and effectiveness of the assigned production unit and/or groups. The individual will act as a senior management representative in the assigned production units and ensure that company policies and guidelines are accurately interpreted and implemented. Develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes and methods in accordance with product specifications and quality standards. Minimize process variation and maximize efficiency of both existing and new product manufacturing process.
 
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 
Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodation for disabilities may be made for one or more of the following:
 
 

* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for profit and loss results as established for the assigned production units by the organization’s budget or forecast process.
* Responsible for achieving and sustaining agreed health and safety goals while using effective management techniques to communicate goals, corrective action and create an environment of best-in-class safety practices.
* Responsible for the manufacturing and planning of best-in-class products in the assigned factory, utilizing world class techniques, clear achievable goals that align with the corporate business strategy.
* Ensure customer service levels are met and that delivery/quality Key Production Indicators (KPI) are tracked and communicated.
* Responsible for staff development, assessments, and ensuring new team members selected to join the organization have the training and development necessary to integrate them into our continuous improvement culture.
* Establishes goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPI) to assigned production units to be flowed down from P&L, HSE, Customer Service Performance, and Quality goals that are communicated and tracked on a regular basis to ensure production group activity aligns with production unit goals.
* Works with inter-departmental or cross functional staff to resolve issues with machinery, product quality, product development, Health, Safety, and Environmental, and continuous improvement.
* Develops, implements, and tracks clear action plans to improve agreed upon deficiencies with the use of problem-solving techniques, such as 8D corrective actions, statistics, capability studies (SPC), Total Preventative Maintenance (TPM).
* Plans and develops capital equipment forecasts using input from others, in order to achieve safety improvements, increased productivity, and optimizes our core skills.
* Manages professional and non-professional staff to achieve their goals through goal setting, performance appraisals, counseling, and team building.
* Must be able to prioritize and manage resources to achieve projects results even when time and/or resources are constrained.
* Ensure quality management system is adhered to and improved as a part of our continuous improvement effort.
* Organize and maintain high standards of performance, quality and customer service within all departments.
* Responsible for implementing company policies and guidelines as prescribed by management
* Supports, leads, and adheres to all business accreditations, such as AS9100, ISO14001, and others as acquired or required.
* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for and ensuring that all employees attend all training provided and for adhering to all HSE procedures, policies, and plans, conforming to reporting requirements, and safe operating procedures at all times.
* Responsible for ensuring employees in assigned area are aware of their requirement to bring any known or suspected nonconformance for all company procedures or legal requirements to management’s attention immediately.

Ways of Working, Experience, and Behaviors
 
 
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
 
 

* Analytical – Ability to analyze and understand complex information, product specification, and critical technical information. Able to resolve complex problems to resolution. Able to scrutinize information providing direction and guidance on risks, strategy, planning, and actions
* Technical Skills – Technical knowledge including but not limited, to specification interpretation, product application, product quality, quality systems, International Standards, safety and environmental management, customer relationship management, project management, Lean concepts, Six-Sigma, and people development and leadership.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens intently to others and seeks clarification; Provides clear and pleasant responses to inquiries regardless of the situation; Presents complex concepts in a simple manner to achieve understanding at all levels of the organization. Demonstrates group presentation skills working in a global environment; actively participates in meetings providing clear information.
* Written Communication – Writes documents clearly and accurately. Transfers production data into meaningful written documents that can be understood by all levels of the organization. Writes comprehensive well-developed policies and work instructions. Writes clear actions and audit reports.
* Teamwork - As management Team Member must lead by example, adhere and apply all company and legal regulations. Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Places success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed; Follows the company guiding principles and values; Recognizes accomplishments of team members.
* Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns actions and department activities and action plans to mission, vision and strategic goals.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities of self and others; Uses time efficiently; Plans for resources in a creative way only adding cost as absolutely necessary; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

Supervisory Responsibilities
 
 
Directly and/or indirectly supervises Supervisors/Managers, and other team members assigned to the production units and production groups; Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the assigned production units. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the HSE responsibility, organization's policies and applicable laws; Responsibilities include but are not limited to interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
 
 
ESSENTIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
 
 
Education and/or Experience
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree (Engineering background preferred) from a four-year college or university. Master’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience in the Aerospace Industry or Manufacturing environment preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years related experience required or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Customer interface/interaction experience related to understanding of customer specifications, quality and satisfaction required.

Language Skills
 
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Must be able to write accurate reports, business correspondence, technical manuals, policies, and procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
 
 
Mathematical Skills
 
Ability to work with highly complex mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
 
 
Reasoning Ability
 
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract concrete variables.
 
 
Computer Skills
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have advanced knowledge of Computer software programs for word processing, spreadsheets, presentation such as but not limited to Microsoft Word; Microsoft Excel; Microsoft Access, Project Plan or corrective Action system.
 
 
Certificates, licenses, registrations
 
 
PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT, HEALTH AND ,SAFETY
 
 
Physical Demands
 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
 
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time, and to speak or listen. The employee is frequently required to sit and requires eye-hand coordination, repetitive hand movement and manual dexterity use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand for extended periods of time and walk. The employee must occasionally bend, reach to shoulder level and lift, carrying, pushing and/or pulling up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus. Hearing level within normal/average range.
 
 
Work Environment
 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud in the manufacturing unit.
 
Safety and Environmental
 
The responsibilities of the position include compliance with company and governmental safety, environmental and hazardous materials regulations and procedures. Employees will be required to wear personal safety equipment such as safety glasses, hearing protection, or proper footwear PPE in specified areas.
 
 
Fully responsible for implementing safety and environmental rules within area of responsibility. Must uphold all safety standards and have in-depth knowledge of safety. Must be a coach and model safety excellence by wearing prescribed PPE and ensuring employees under his span of control are adhering to all safety rules. Has ultimate responsibility and authority to stop production if any hazard is present that may affect the safety of the employees in the shift.
 
 

* Ensure compliance with HSE procedures, instructions, guidelines and golden rules
* Ensure that the HSE procedures and instructions of his/her department are always adapted and updated
* Ensure the acquisition and maintenance of HSE skills of its employees in relation to the tasks performed by its teams
* Ensure that the equipment under his/her responsibility is in good condition and operates safely. If this is not the case, he/she will ensure that protective measures are taken and/or that the equipment is consigned
* Identify and deal with HSE risk situations during the appropriate PSM
* Manage emergency situations with the help of the first aiders and first response team members
* Relay and lead HSE communication within his/her teams
* Ensure that the necessary resources are available to guarantee the preservation of the health and safety of the people in his/her department
* Ensure that the necessary resources are made available to guarantee the limitation of the environmental impact of his/her department
* Within his/her scope, implement actions to achieve the site's HSE objectives
* Participating to the HSE management review

LISI is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

records.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health begin on Day 1.
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

 

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $166,400 to $208,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). Learn more about Hershey’s benefits and all the resources Hershey provides to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial well‑being by visiting the Hershey Digital Employee Experience at www.askHRbenefits.hersheys.com

The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The policy of The Hershey Company is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
The Hershey Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority/Female/Disabled/Protected Veterans. You may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our online application process as a result of a disability. 
You can request an accommodation via phone or email.To request an accommodation via phone, please call +1 877-804-1794 and leave a voicemail with your contact information. You may also email a request for accommodation to ApplicationHelp@hersheys.com. Please be sure to include “Accommodation Needed” in the subject line. This will ensure that your email is routed to the appropriate contact who will handle your request.

records.description:
**Company Overview**

Delta Galil USA, Inc. is a global manufacturer and marketer of branded and private label apparel products for men, women and children. Since its inception in 1975, the company has continually endeavored to create products that follow a body-before-fabric philosophy, placing equal emphasis on comfort, aesthetics and quality. Delta Galil develops innovative seamless apparel, including bras, shapewear and socks; intimate apparel for women; underwear for men, including under its owned brands Schiesser, Eminence, Organic Basics and Athena; babywear, activewear, sleepwear and loungewear, including under its owned P.J. Salvage and Delta brands. Delta Galil also designs, develops, markets and sells branded denim and apparel under the brand 7 For All Mankind®, and ladies’ and kids’ apparel under the brand Splendid®. In addition, it sells its products under brand names licensed to the company, including adidas, Wolford, Wilson, Columbia, Tommy Hilfiger and others.

**Position Overview**

At Delta Galil, great product only matters if it reaches the shelf at the right cost, at the right quality and on time. As Director, Production & Sourcing, you’ll make that happen. You’ll own Sourcing and Production for your programs, from the first seasonal projection to the moment goods land at our Distribution Center, steering a global network of mills, factories and overseas offices that supply some of the biggest names in mass-market retail.

This is a role with real levers. You’ll negotiate the costs that shape the department’s margin, decide where programs are placed and how capacity is allocated, and lead the cross-functional team through every approval milestone, from BOM handoff to TOP. You’ll partner every day with Design, Planning and our Domestic and Offshore QA teams, and you’ll be the person everyone looks to when a delivery is at risk.

You’ll thrive here if you’re a natural negotiator and a hands-on leader who knows a garment down to its cost components, stays calm when a test fails or a vessel slips, and gets energy from turning a complex calendar into on-time deliveries.

**Key Responsibilities**

Sourcing, Costing & Vendor Strategy

* Share seasonal projections with mills and factories early, locking in key delivery dates and a generic TNA well ahead of order placement.
* Lead program-level cost negotiations that drive best costs and help the department meet or beat seasonal margin goals.
* Build and grow a strong vendor matrix that supports the business’s long-term needs.
* Place programs with overseas mills, factories and offices on time, with program-specific TNAs, the right capacity allocation and production plans that hit contracted deliveries.

Production Execution & Approvals

* Lead the cross-functional team through program TNAs, driving approvals from completed BOM handoff through color and components, fit, pre-production, testing and TOP.
* Work with stakeholders to resolve approval issues and testing failures quickly, escalating to leadership when needed.
* Assess production issues for delivery impact and lead cross-functional decisions on quality levels and ship-mode changes to protect customer deliveries.

Planning, Capacity & Delivery

* Partner with the Planning team to support the business at the right stock levels.
* Own and communicate monthly program capacity plans to mills and factories, flagging loading or capacity risks early.
* Keep POs current in the system, hold factories to timely bookings and approve vessel schedules that line up with customer deliveries.
* Build and maintain delivery reports for weekly team review.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Partner with Domestic and Offshore QA, sharing planned program allocation before placement.
* Champion critical QA steps before, during and at the end of production so product arrives at the Distribution Center free of quality issues and every customer order ships on time.
* Work with management to improve process flow and roll out new initiatives.

 
Requirements: 
 

* Minimum years of apparel experience across Product Development, Production, QA and Testing.
* Experience supplying a big-box, mass-market retailer such as Target or Walmart.
* Cut-and-sew knits experience (activewear strongly preferred).
* Deep knowledge of manufacturing, testing and quality control, including fabrics, trims and garment cost components (YY, CM, AU).
* A proven team leader with exceptional negotiation and problem-solving skills with factories and material suppliers.

records.title: Director of Operations (PCNY - Queens)
records.description:
**ABOUT US:** 
With a dedication to our people and our products, The Honickman Companies® are collectively one of the largest independent beverage employers in the country. Our Pepsi business includes distribution for brands like Pepsi-Cola, Starbucks, Lipton Teas, Gatorade, Evian and more, throughout the 5 Borough’s, Long Island, Westchester and Pennsauken NJ. If you are excited to work with some of the biggest brands in the world, in the biggest brand market in the world, come see what we have to offer. a passionate, self-motivated, and detail-oriented team player who is committed to the success of our customers. You will focus on growing and developing existing clients, as well as generating new business by identifying, implementing and executing new strategies.
 
 
**SUMMARY:** 
Leads the day-to-day operations of a large-scale beverage manufacturing facility, with overall accountability for Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing. Establishes operating priorities and develops leaders and teams to deliver safe, high-quality, cost-effective and efficient production. Applies practical business judgment, disciplined execution and continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System to improve plant performance and support the Company’s business strategy.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Provides visible, hands-on leadership and direction for all plant operations, including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing.
* Establishes clear operating priorities, performance expectations and accountability; aligns staffing, resources and production plans with customer and business requirements.
* Ensures production schedules are achieved while meeting safety, food safety, quality, efficiency, cost and customer service expectations.
* Monitors and acts upon key performance indicators, including safety performance, schedule attainment, production efficiency, equipment utilization, downtime, waste, labor productivity, inventory accuracy and service levels.
* Identifies operating constraints and performance gaps; leads root cause analysis, corrective actions and practical solutions that improve throughput, reliability and execution.
* Ensures manufacturing processes, standard operating procedures and controls are documented, consistently followed and improved as business needs evolve.
* Partners with Quality leadership to maintain effective food safety, sanitation, preventive control and quality systems and to resolve customer complaints, audit findings and corrective actions promptly.
* Provides leadership and oversight for preventive and predictive maintenance, work-order execution and equipment reliability; aligns maintenance priorities with production requirements and long-term asset needs.
* Supports capital planning and execution, including equipment upgrades, facility improvements and other investments that improve safety, capacity, reliability or cost performance.
* Oversees warehouse, inventory control, shipping and receiving operations to ensure accurate inventory, efficient material flow, appropriate space utilization and timely customer shipments.
* Drives practical, results-oriented continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System; ensures initiatives produce measurable gains in safety, quality, productivity, waste, cost and equipment effectiveness.
* Develops and manages operating plans and budgets; controls labor, overtime, waste, operating expense and other key financial measures while balancing service and production needs.
* Leads, develops and holds department managers and supervisors accountable; builds leadership capability, cross-functional collaboration and a strong succession pipeline.
* Builds a culture of teamwork, communication, employee engagement and ownership by maintaining a regular presence on the plant floor and engaging employees at all levels.
* Establishes productive relationships with employees and union representatives; ensures consistent application of Company policies, procedures and applicable collective bargaining agreements and addresses employee relations matters promptly and professionally.
* Promotes a proactive safety culture and ensures compliance with applicable OSHA, environmental, food safety, regulatory and customer requirements; directs timely incident investigations and corrective actions.
* Provides accurate and timely operating reports, communicates plant performance and risks, and recommends actions needed to achieve business objectives.
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:** 
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 

* Comprehensive knowledge of large-scale manufacturing operations, production planning, equipment reliability, quality systems, food safety, warehousing, distribution and inventory controls.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to develop operating plans, manage budgets and labor costs, interpret performance data and translate findings into action.
* Practical knowledge of continuous improvement, root cause analysis, standard work and performance management; ability to implement solutions that deliver measurable operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a complex operation through multiple levels of management and to establish priorities, accountability and disciplined execution across functions.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental and food-manufacturing regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain effective safety, quality and compliance systems.
* Proven ability to lead and develop managers and supervisors, engage a diverse hourly workforce and build effective labor-management relationships in a union environment.
* Excellent judgment, problem-solving, organizational and follow-up skills; able to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a fast-paced operation.
* Effective oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate expectations, performance, risks and recommendations to employees, leaders and senior management.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; familiarity with manufacturing, maintenance, warehouse and performance-reporting systems.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including prior overall responsibility as a plant, site or operations leader for a large, complex manufacturing facility.
* Prior responsibility for multiple functions, including Production, Quality, Maintenance and Warehouse/Distribution operations, with demonstrated success improving plant performance.
* Beverage manufacturing experience strongly preferred; significant food manufacturing experience will also be considered.
* Experience leading a unionized manufacturing workforce strongly preferred.
* Experience managing operating budgets, labor costs, productivity, equipment reliability, quality, safety and overall plant performance required.
* Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS / WORK ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL:** 

* Manufacturing, warehouse and office environments; regular presence on the production floor is required.
* Must be able to work around moving equipment, elevated noise levels, temperature variation and other conditions typical of a beverage manufacturing facility, with required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to move throughout the facility and occasionally lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule and respond to operational needs outside normal business hours; limited travel may be required.

**COMPENSATION RANGE:** 
Potential earning is from $190,000.00 - $215,000.00 annually
 
 
The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required by personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the company.
 
 

* We do not provide application status due to overwhelming volume. If your skills meet our needs, we will contact you to move forward in the process.\*

\*\*EOE without regard to race, color, religion, creed, affectional or sexual orientation or sex, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetics, veteran status, gender, gender identity, citizenship status, marital status, VEVRAA Federal Contractor.\*\*
 
\*\*\*If you have a disability and you need an accommodation to apply, please contact us at hiring@hongrp.com

records.title: Plant Director
records.description:
**Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.**
============================================================================================================================================

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

**Job Description**
===================

To manage and lead overall plant operations ensuring the achievement of plant targets for Safety, Quality, Service and Cost. This will be executed through providing strong leadership to the plant team and managing the systems, equipment, people and materials according to the established policies, procedures, specifications, and customer requirements. This individual reports directly to the Director-Manufacturing. The Plant Lead Team members will report directly to the Plant Manager (typically 6-10 direct reports) Scope for this Plant Manager role is a medium to large-sized facility with typically greater than 300 employees and mid to high-level complexity.

**WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

* Leads and drives plant safety culture and puts safety first in all responsibilities.
* Leads identification of opportunities and problem areas for targeted improvement by creating, reviewing and monitoring data or reports that show performance to KPI's. (specifically, safety, quality, waste, and productivity)
* Oversees all aspects of human capital planning & management for the facility, including HC goal setting, improvement targets for KPI's, salary planning, performance management.
* Attract, hire, develop direct reports and create strong succession plans
* Ensure compliance with department safety, product safety, fire protection, Company polices/procedures, and housekeeping programs.
* Ensures effective, timely and well-developed communications for all product associates.
* Manage process control initiatives by ensuring manufacturing SOP's exist, and that they are sufficient for quality, safety, and process control.
* Leads plant budgeting processes
* Ensures execution of plant Cap-Ex
* Lead and ensure growth of CI culture by providing resources, participating in teams, and leading teams as necessary.
* Ensures facility compliance with local, state and federal regulatory agencies.
* Drives employee engagement action planning for the facility
* Leads communication to all plant associates regarding business needs and results
* Leads efforts at Best Practice sharing with other facilities
* Meets safety targets and drives a safety culture and environment to send every employee home everyday without injury.
* Meets or exceeds plant business plan and KPI’s.
* Delivers on established budget.
* Best Practices leadership
* Effective, cost-efficient planning and utilization of manpower, materials and machinery.
* Strong Human Capital planning, development and management for the facility.
* Drives High Performance Culture
* Plant talent to deliver on plan

 **WHAT WE VALUE**
* Strong financial acumen
* Results Orientation / Delivers on Plan
* Team Leadership
* Develops Organizational Capability
* Strategic Orientation / Enterprise Thinker
* Collaboration & Influence
* Change Leadership
* Facility Business Acumen/Market Knowledge

**WHAT WE WANT FROM YOU**

* A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, or related field
* 10+ years of relevant experience in a production environment
* Demonstrated passion for safety
* 7+ years of leadership experience, preferably in flexible packaging
* Lives Amcor Values and leads by example
* Proven ability to lead and drive continuous improvement
* Strong Customer Service mindset
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated knowledge of BNA customers and plant capabilities
* Demonstrated understanding of drivers of plant results, including ability to interpret financial results
* Demonstrated CI knowledge, Six Sigma Black Belt certification strongly preferred

**Our Expectations**
====================

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

* Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
* Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
* Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
* The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

**Equal Opportunity** **Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual** **Orientation/Gender Identity**
==============================================================================================================

Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the *"Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster*. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

**E-Verify**
============

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

**Compensation**
================

The starting salary for this position is expected to be between $176,100 to $242,100 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base pay information is based on national averages and a geographic differential may be applied based on work location. Position may also be eligible for Amcor’s Management Incentive Plan / Sales Incentive Plan, which is an annual bonus program based on business and individual performance, as well as medical coverage and other health and welfare benefits. The salary range provided reflects the anticipated starting salary base pay for this role at the time of this posting and does not necessarily reflect full earning potential over the course of employment. This range is applicable to positions performed in jurisdictions with pay transparency requirements, including CA, CO, CT, HI, IL, MD, MA, MN, NV, NJ, NY, RI, VT, WA, Washington DC, as well as remote roles that may be performed in these locations. Compensation for roles performed outside of these jurisdictions may vary. The Company reserves the right to modify this range at any time.

**Benefits**
============

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

* Medical, dental and vision plans
* Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees
* Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location
* Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program
* Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account
* Life insurance, AD&D, short-term & long-term disability, and voluntary benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval)
* Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)
