records.title: Plant Manager IV
records.description:
PLANT MANAGER
 
 
**About Voltava:** 
At Voltava, people power everything we do. We are a premier global manufacturing and assembly partner formed through the combination of Detroit Manufacturing Systems, Android Industries, and Avancez with approximately 5,400 Team Members across 21 facilities worldwide. Our vibrant, collaborative, and people-focused culture is the foundation for everything we deliver, from complex module assembly and sequencing to contract manufacturing, supply chain, automation, and tooling and equipment design for OEM customers across the automotive, industrial, e-mobility, heavy truck, defense, and technology sectors. Kinetyc, our scalable contract manufacturing arm based in Wixom, Michigan, expands our capabilities and capacity to support customers across a range of industries. Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
 
 
**About the Role:** 
**At Voltava, we're Building Better Manufacturing:** operations where people, technology, and operational excellence come together to deliver exceptional results.
 
As Plant Manager, you will run the full production operation for your customer-centric unit, including Materials, Assembly, Shipping, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering. You own results in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and people, and you build the leadership bench that sustains them.
 
This is a highly visible role for a leader who pairs operational depth and business acumen with a servant leadership mindset. You will build an engaged, high-performing culture while leading deployment of VIBE (Voltava Business System) and the Daily Management System (DMS), continuous improvement, and the adoption of AI, automation, and best-in-class manufacturing technology on the shop floor.
 
 
**What You Will Do:** 

* Own plant performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and employee engagement.
* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, with real succession depth at every level.
* Champion servant leadership grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration, and employee development.
* Turn employee feedback into visible action that improves employee experience.
* Use KPIs and operational data to track performance, solve problems at the root, and drive continuous improvement.
* Lead implementation of VIBE (Voltava Business System) at the plant, embedding Lean Manufacturing, standardized work, 5S, and PFEP as the daily operating system.
* Own plant adoption of the Daily Management System (DMS): establish daily routines for reviewing performance, escalating and solving problems, and holding leaders accountable for consistent execution.
* Lead innovation and the implementation of AI solutions, automation, and advanced technology that modernize the shop floor and improve safety, quality, productivity, profitability, and efficiency.
* Sustain compliance with EHS, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and quality and regulatory requirements.
* Secure the staffing, resources, and capabilities needed to meet production and financial objectives.
* Partner across functions on new business, quoting, capacity planning, customer requirements, and improvement initiatives.

**What You Need To Be Successful:** 

* 10+ years of automotive manufacturing experience, including 5+ years in progressively senior leadership roles.
* Track record leading high-performing manufacturing operations and developing strong leadership teams.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Experience implementing and sustaining an operating system and daily management routines; familiarity with VIBE (Voltava Business System) and Daily Management System (DMS) is a plus.
* Servant leadership mindset, with demonstrated success building culture, engagement, accountability, and talent.
* Experience using KPIs and operational data to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Strong financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a manufacturing environment.
* Preferred: experience championing innovation, automation, AI, or emerging manufacturing technologies.
* Clear communicator and collaborator who can influence and lead at every level of the organization.

**What Success Looks Like:** 
Success means a plant where people are engaged, leaders are empowered, VIBE and DMS drive consistent daily execution, technology enables better performance, and operational excellence is part of how we work every day.
 
 
**You will know you are making an impact when:** 

* Safety is part of the culture, and leaders and team members take ownership every day.
* The plant delivers consistent results in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Employee engagement keeps improving, with real follow-through on feedback.
* Leaders model servant leadership and create an environment of trust, accountability, collaboration, respect, and development.
* Innovation projects and new technologies, including AI and advanced manufacturing solutions, are implemented and deliver measurable improvements on the shop floor and in the office.
* Teams embrace continuous improvement and keep finding smarter, safer, more efficient ways to work.
* VIBE and the Daily Management System are fully implemented and sustained, with daily management routines running consistently, leaders accountable for them, and results that hold.
* The leadership pipeline is strong, with talented team members developed and ready for their next role.
* Customers see consistent quality, reliable delivery, and a true partnership with Voltava.

**Education:** 

* Bachelor's degree required (Management, Business, or Engineering); MBA or master's degree in Business Management preferred.

**Travel:** 

* Up to 25%

**What We Offer:** 
Our team members are our greatest investment. Our total rewards package supports you at every stage of your career and life, and may include comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings with employer contributions; tuition reimbursement; paid time off and holidays; employee assistance resources; and wellness programs that support your health, financial well-being, and professional growth.
 
 
**Our Core Values:** 
Voltava is committed to creating an environment where every Team Member feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to make an impact.
 

* Respect: We create belonging by bringing out the best in each other.
* Integrity: We earn trust through every interaction.
* Courage: We show up fully even when it would be easier not to.
* Impact: We strengthen the people and places around us.

Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
 
Voltava is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
At Voltava, employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate, serve our customers, and achieve our goals.
 
Accessibility and Accommodations
 
Voltava is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@voltava.com. Requests for accommodation will be reviewed and considered in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

records.title: Director, Kinder Bueno Production Operations
records.description:
Manufacturing

Job ID:

78426

Bloomington, IL, US (On-Site)

Permanent

 

About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Senior Production Manager, Kinder Bueno and are actively reviewing applications.

Reporting to the Plant Manager, you will be responsible for leading, directing, and overseeing all day-to-day production operations for Kinder Bueno, ensuring that operational objectives, production targets, and quality standards are consistently achieved in a safe, efficient, and cost-effective manner.

You will provide strategic and operational leadership to the production team, driving continuous improvement, operational excellence, and the development of innovative solutions to enhance product quality, productivity, and overall manufacturing performance.

You will serve as a key point of reference for all activities related to product development, process optimization, and innovation. Through effective leadership, collaboration, and resource management, you will ensure alignment with company objectives while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

You will be responsible for upholding and promoting all company policies, procedures, and operational standards, with particular emphasis on food safety, quality assurance, environmental responsibility, and health and safety.

 

Main Responsibilities:

Production & Operational Management

* Lead and oversee daily production activities to ensure production schedules, operational targets, and delivery commitments are consistently met.
* Ensure finished products are manufactured in accordance with established quality standards, specifications, and production timelines.
* Manage, support, and continuously develop a team of Production Supervisors, providing direction, guidance, and accountability to ensure effective execution of production plans.
* Partner with the Planning Department and Production Supervisors to develop, coordinate, and execute weekly production schedules.
* Monitor production performance, identify operational challenges, and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency, productivity, and cost effectiveness.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on identifying and eliminating technical, technological, and operational challenges across production lines.
* Identify opportunities to optimize manufacturing processes, improve equipment performance, reduce waste, and maximize operational efficiency.
* Coordinate the implementation of new projects, including production lines, product formats, processes, and technological improvements within the assigned area.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to R&D, supply chain, and quality and food safety to support product development, process innovation, and the introduction of new manufacturing capabilities.

**Budget, Maintenance & Resource Management**

* Play a key role in the development, management, and monitoring of the budget, including maintenance, capital investments, production costs, general expenses, and energy consumption.
* Establish maintenance priorities and coordinate interventions in collaboration with the RDM and Maintenance Manager.
* Contribute to the development, review, and continuous improvement of preventive maintenance plans to maximize equipment reliability and operational performance.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to support production objectives while maintaining cost controls and operational efficiency.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Translate and communicate company objectives into clear goals and expectations for the management team.
* Provide effective leadership, coaching, and development to Production Supervisors and their teams.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and establish development opportunities to strengthen individual and team performance.
* Maintain constructive working relationships with labor unions and provide guidance and support to UGP management on effective labor relations practices.

**Safety, Quality & Environmental Compliance**

* Ensure full compliance with company policies, procedures, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) across all production activities.
* Promote and reinforce a strong culture of food safety, product quality, and health and safety throughout the production organization.
* Partner with the ISEE Manager to develop and implement initiatives that improve environmental performance and sustainability.
* Ensure employees understand and consistently adhere to applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and safe operating practices.

About You:

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field required.
* A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing or production management. Experience working in a chocolate / confectionery manufacturing or industrial production environment highly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing production operations, managing teams, and achieving operational and financial performance objectives.
* Strong understanding of raw materials, manufacturing processes, production technologies, quality control, cost management, and production optimization.
* Solid knowledge of business and management principles, including strategic planning, budgeting, resource allocation, workforce planning, leadership, and operational coordination.
* Knowledge of employee relations, labor relations, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), personnel development, and conflict resolution.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities for improvement, solve complex operational challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Working knowledge of production equipment, machinery, and fundamental operating principles within the assigned production area.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**
 
As part of our recruitment process, Ferrero may use artificial intelligence (AI) enabled tools to assist with reviewing candidate applications. These tools are used solely to support recruiters by summarizing application information and identifying potential alignment with job requirements. AI does not independently screen out or select candidates, and it does not replace human judgment. Final decisions regarding candidate progression are always made by Ferrero recruiters and hiring managers.

The base compensation range for this position is $135,453 - $180,604. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This range represents the anticipated salary for this position at this time.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits.

About Ferrero:

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many **iconic brands** sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

DE&I at Ferrero:

Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.
 
Find out more *here*.

Ferrero is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable human rights laws. Ferrero will recruit, hire, train, and promote all persons without regard to race, creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, and gender identity), religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, or history of disability (except where physical or mental abilities are a bona fide occupational requirement and the individual is not able to perform the essential functions of the position even with reasonable accommodations), citizenship, or any other protected characteristic.

Ferrero will accommodate the needs of applicants with disabilities throughout all stages of the selection process. If you need accommodation during the recruitment process, please advise the People & Organization (HR) Representative. Information relating to the need for accommodation and accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

 

**Our Application Process**
---------------------------

We’re constantly looking for talented individuals who are ready to be part of our dynamic and growing organization. Ferrero is a company with a global presence and family values. Join us!

##### **1. Apply**

Complete your online application, upload your CV and include brief cover letter to help us understand your experience and interests

##### **2. Assess**

Our HR team will arrange a phone or video interview if we feel your qualifications are a good match for the job

##### **3. Interview**

If the first interview goes well, you’ll be invited to speak with a Ferrero manager to assess your competencies, technical aptitude and fit within our dynamic organization

records.title: Plant Manager – Soil Cement/RCC Plants
records.description:
Thalle Construction Co., Inc. is pleased to announce a career opportunity for a Plant Manager – Soil Cement/RCC Plants on the Central Everglades Planning Project (CEPP) Everglades Agricultural Area (EAA) A-2 Reservoir in Palm Beach County, Florida. This project marks the largest contract in the Jacksonville District’s history. Thalle will oversee the construction of a 17.75-mile embankment dam and associated structures. This project offers potential Project Team members a valuable opportunity to broaden their professional experience and advance their careers throughout its duration. The CEPP plays a vital role in Everglades restoration, aiming to enhance ecosystem health, improve water storage, and increase resilience to climate change.

Thalle Construction Company (Thalle), established in 1947, is a growing heavy civil construction company. Thalle’s corporate office is in Hillsborough, NC with a regional office in Alvarado, Texas. Thalle has construction projects throughout the South East, Texas, New York and New Jersey. Our diverse and expansive project scope of heavy civil infrastructure projects includes dams, reservoirs, locks, DOT roadway construction and bridges, large diameter utilities, landfills, mass excavation, wastewater, on-demand emergency services.

We are a proud representative of the Tully Group (**www.tullygroup.us**). The Tully Group is one of the nation’s largest privately held, family owned construction firms with their corporate office in New York City and a long history of heavy civil projects in the Metro New York Area and New Jersey.

Safety is our TOP priority! Thalle celebrates industry leading safety performance that demonstrates our strong safety culture and commitment to safe operations.

Thalle offers a competitive salary package with a full range of benefits, including Major Medical, Dental, Vision, Short and Long-Term Disability, generous PTO, paid company holidays, Life Insurance, and 401K with a company match, and more! Compensation is based on experience and qualifications.

Thalle is an Equal Opportunity Employer, E-Verify and Drug Free Workplace.

**Location****:** South Bay, FL

**Title:** Plant Manager – Soil Cement/RCC Plants

**Salary:** *Competetive Compensation Package Based on Experience*

**Overview:**

The Plant Manager – Soil Cement/RCC Plants will oversee the operation, production, maintenance, and performance of soil cement and RCC plants supporting a large-scale heavy civil infrastructure project. This position will be responsible for ensuring the plant operates safely and efficiently while meeting production requirements, quality specifications, project schedules, and environmental requirements.

The Plant Manager will work closely with project management, field operations, quality control, equipment, maintenance, and subcontractor teams to coordinate material production and delivery to the placement operation.

* Manage the day-to-day operation of soil cement and/or RCC production plants supporting large-scale heavy civil construction.
* Oversee plant production to ensure required quantities, production rates, and material specifications are consistently achieved.
* Coordinate plant operations with field crews responsible for material placement, grading, spreading, and compaction.
* Monitor production schedules and adjust plant operations to meet project demands and placement requirements.
* Supervise plant personnel, operators, mechanics, and other support staff.
* Coordinate equipment maintenance, repairs, inspections, and preventative maintenance to minimize production downtime.
* Monitor the availability and quality of raw materials, including cement, aggregates, soil, water, and other materials required for production.
* Work closely with Quality Control and laboratory personnel to ensure mix designs, moisture content, cement content, density, strength, and other testing requirements are being met.
* Monitor plant batching, mixing, and material handling operations to maintain consistent production and quality.
* Review production reports, plant data, material quantities, testing results, and daily operational records.
* Troubleshoot production, equipment, material, and quality issues and coordinate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with project management and field leadership regarding production rates, plant capacity, upcoming work, and operational constraints.
* Assist with planning plant setup, material stockpiles, haul routes, equipment requirements, and production sequencing.
* Ensure plant operations comply with project specifications, safety requirements, environmental regulations, and company policies.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure employees receive appropriate training and follow established procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, subcontractors, and equipment personnel as needed.
* Track production costs, labor, materials, equipment utilization, and other operational metrics.
* Maintain accurate plant records and documentation required by the project and owner.
* Participate in project meetings and provide updates regarding plant production, maintenance, staffing, and operational performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve plant efficiency, production capacity, material utilization, and overall project performance.

### **Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in heavy civil construction, materials production, concrete production, soil cement, RCC, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of soil cement and/or RCC production, batching, mixing, material handling, and placement operations.
* Experience working on large-scale dam, reservoir, embankment, water infrastructure, transportation, or other heavy civil projects is strongly preferred.
* Experience supervising plant personnel, operators, mechanics, and production teams.
* Strong understanding of construction materials, quality control, testing requirements, and project specifications.
* Ability to coordinate multiple crews and departments in a high-production construction environment.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to plant operations and equipment.
* Ability to read and understand project plans, specifications, mix designs, and production requirements.
* Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
* Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications and construction/project management software.
* Ability to work extended hours, weekends, shifts, and varying schedules as required by project operations.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to perform the essential job functions consistent safely and successfully with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards.
* Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on telephone.

**Experience:** Minimum three years’ related experience in a healthcare setting with some administrative and supervisory responsibility. Considerable experience in maintenance, plant operation and construction.

records.title: Senior Manager Operational Excellence Initiatives
records.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

CVS is seeking a Senior Manager to own the end-to-end process and technology strategy for stocking and picking across CVS Distribution. This role sits within the Operational Excellence (OpEx) Initiatives team, reporting to the Executive Director of Operational Excellence Initiatives (whose peers lead the OpEx Regional and OpEx Analytics organizations), alongside three other Senior Managers and a team of Managers/Senior Analysts. This role has two direct reports. Where peer Senior Managers on the team own the inbound-through-machine-replenishment and inbound/outbound value streams, this role owns the network's stocking and picking processes – the highest-volume and most labor-intensive processes in our network. This individual will also serve as the process-side subject matter expert on Warehouse Management System (WMS) configuration within owned value streams, to ensure system and process are in alignment. The role requires approximately 30–50% travel, often in stretches on an every-other-week cadence.

Responsibilities:

* **Technology Deployment (50%) —** Own the 3-year technology roadmap for stocking, picking, and module support, including code updates to existing processes, new process rollouts, and major enhancements, to improve colleague experience, quality, and productivity.
* + **Success Measures** — Deliver measurable improvements in inventory accuracy, stocking and picking quality defects, and throughput, specific to each enhancement or process change.
* **Process Optimization (15%) —** Own the process and technology, and advise on WMS configuration needs within your value streams, working with the other subject matter experts on the team who consult on and implement WMS changes, to tune system settings, improve operations, and keep WMS, technology, and process aligned across stocking and picking:
* + **Stocking —** Own the process and core technology for replenishing split-case picking modules
* + **Picking —** Own the process and core technology for picking across multiple picking methods, including split case and full case, in both active pick slots and reserve storage locations
* **Project & Change Management (25%) —** Plan and execute multiple concurrent projects (typically 4–5 programs in parallel, with a rollout roughly every other week across approximately 2,000 associates), applying strong project management skills — managing risk, critical path, dependencies, and budget — to meet project goals on time. Larger programs are led by the network Center of Excellence (COE); on others, this role provides oversight while the site leads. Build the financial business case and project plan for new opportunities, and ensure robust follow-through on changes to sustain results.
* **Mentorship/Training (10%)—** Grow and shape the organization's lean capability, developing training content and standard work that enhances the continuous improvement culture across the network. Lead, coach, and develop direct reports.

This is a work-from-home role with travel; relocation is not offered. The ideal candidate is located near one of the following distribution centers: La Habra (CA), Patterson (CA), Conroe (TX), Lumberton (NJ), Woonsocket (RI), Chemung (NY), Novi (DT), Kansas City (MO), Indianapolis (IN), Orlando (FL), North Augusta (SC), Fredericksburg (VA), or Knoxville (TN).

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering/science field or additional 4 years of experience in the requirements below
* 6+ years' experience in a manufacturing or distribution center environment
* 4+ years of demonstrated success and experience in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence in a manufacturing or warehouse operation
* 4+ years of demonstrated success in managing projects
* 4+ years of experience with WMS, ERP, MES, or LMS systems and database structure

* 2+ years of experience with SQL
* Proven ability to influence and partner with operations, IT, and finance leaders; strong written and verbal communication; self-motivated and effective at managing multiple priorities 
 
 **Preferred Qualifications**
* 9+ years' experience in a manufacturing or distribution center environment
* 6+ years as continuous improvement, industrial engineering, or process engineering
* 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure Snowflake semantic modeling and Power BI
* 2+ years running operations (plant manager, senior operations manager, etc.)
* Certified in standards-based time and motion study systems such as MOST and MTM
* APICS CPIM, CSCP, or CLTD Certified
* PMP Certified
* Six Sigma Black Belt Certified

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$82,940.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/14/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Description:

**Built** **on** **Experience.** **Built** **for** **Skill.** **Built** **for You.**

Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.

That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.

We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.

**Your Mission:**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.

**Explore the Depth of the Role:**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

*Travel Requirements:*

Between facilities as needed

*Physical Requirements:*

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

**Become** **a** **part** **of** **our** **Builders** **and** **you** **too** **can...**

* Uphold Safety and Quality Standards
* Embody Team Spirit
* Relentless Customer Focus
* Convey Integrity, Trust, and Professionalism
* Execute with Excellence and Velocity

**What** **Keel** **will** **build** **for** **you:**

* Comprehensive Benefit Package
* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) Match
* HSA/FSA
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off
* Internal Referral Bonus Opportunities
* Shift Differentials
* Overtime Potential
* Paid on the Job Training
* Certification Sponsorship Opportunities
* Committed to Individual Career Growth
* We Do Fun Things, Plus More!

**Need** **Assistance?**

If you require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the employment process, please email talent@keelusa.com with details about your request and your contact information. Accommodation requests are reviewed individually on a case-by-case basis. Please note that this email address is monitored only for inquiries related to reasonable accommodation requests.

*Equal* *Opportunity* *Employer* */* *Individuals* *with* *Disabilities* */* *Protected Veterans*

**What** **we** **build,** **builds us.**

* Develop and implement a comprehensive quality strategy for welding, electrical, and fabrication operations.
* Lead cross-functional teams across multiple shifts to ensure quality objectives are met.
* Engage with C-suite and customers to communicate quality performance and respond to inquiries.

* Oversee continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Build and maintain a responsive customer communication framework to address quality concerns.

* BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Management
* 10+ years of experience in a discrete manufacturing environment of electro-mechanical equipment

* 8+ years of experience in high level customer engagement - C-suite communication
* Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams (welding, electricians, quality) across multiple shifts and operations
* Experience with ISO certifications, recerts, audits
* Experience in a welding/fabrication environment
* Experience in an electrical background

### **Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in UL
* Strong understanding of welding processes

### **Benefits:**

* Salary: $150-180K
* Annual bonus plan 15-25% on target bonus

**Position Role Type:**

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The OPM & NPI Lead serves as the primary operational leader responsible for the successful execution of both sustaining programs and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives. This role provides leadership for a team of Operations Product Managers while ensuring operational readiness, production launch success, customer commitment attainment, and portfolio performance. Acting as the operational integrator between General Management, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and SIOP functions, the OPM & NPI Lead drives execution across the entire product lifecycle. The role ensures new products transition effectively from development into production while maintaining delivery, cost, quality, inventory, and capacity objectives for existing programs.

Must be willing and able to travel 15% of the time.

**What You Will Do:**

*Portfolio Leadership*

* Provide operations leadership within Program Management Teams
* Lead and develop a team of Operations Product Managers
* Establish priorities and allocate resources across product portfolios
* Ensure alignment of customer commitments with manufacturing capacity
* Lead portfolio reviews and executive status reporting
* Support business growth initiatives and strategic program execution
* Develop business cases supporting investments and growth opportunities

*New Product Introduction (NPI)*

* Lead operational execution of NPI programs from concept through production stabilization
* Conduct manufacturing feasibility and producibility assessments
* Ensure readiness of labor, equipment, tooling, facilities, materials, and processes
* Lead launch readiness reviews and milestone assessments
* Manage transition from development to recurring production
* Manufacturing Operations Leadership
* Translate forecasted demand into executable manufacturing plans
* Lead recovery efforts for missed deliveries and production disruptions
* Develop capacity models and identify future resource requirements
* Manage operational risks and mitigation strategies

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
* 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing, operations, program management, or NPI leadership
* 5+ years of leadership experience with direct reports
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a complex manufacturing environment
* 3+ years experience managing new product introductions and production transitions
* Understanding of SIOP, capacity planning, production control, and operational performance metrics

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, or related discipline
* Aerospace or defense manufacturing experience
* Electron Beam Welding (EBW)
* Electro Chemical Machining (ECM)
* Precision machining and assembly operations
* Special process manufacturing
* AS9100 and NADCAP experience
* Lean Manufacturing, CORE, Six Sigma, or PMP certification
* Experience with SAP, MES/Solumina, Pelico, Power BI, Tableau, and advanced planning systems
* Experience leading operational recovery and turnaround initiatives

**What We Offer:**

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

**Some of our competitive benefits package includes:**

* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, andreimbursement family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More and Apply Now:**

**Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

 

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other - propel us all higher, again and again. Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance
records.description:
Denali Therapeutics Inc. is a biotechnology company pioneering a new class of biotherapeutics designed to cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB) using its proprietary TransportVehicle™ platform. With the first FDA-approved biologic specifically designed to cross the BBB, a clinically validated delivery platform and a growing portfolio of therapeutic candidates across all stages of development, we are advancing toward our goal of delivering effective medicines to transform the lives of people living with neurodegenerative diseases, lysosomal storage disorders and other serious diseases.

 
 

We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients.

Based in Salt Lake City (SLC), the Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA) will drive quality assurance defined strategies and objectives for a new large molecule drug substance clinical and commercial manufacturing facility. This includes manufacturing and analytical testing operations, ensuring compliance with FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements. This role manages a team responsible for key quality systems including quality on the floor, batch disposition, quality events, GMP documentation and validation.. The position also partners with Manufacturing, QC, and CMC teams to maintain product quality, data integrity, and inspection readiness. The Senior Manager, QA also drives continuous improvement and fosters a strong culture of GMP compliance and operational excellence.

**Key Accountabilities / Core Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership to strengthen site quality systems and elevate overall regulatory compliance across manufacturing and testing operations.
* Provide quality oversight for GMP manufacturing and QC laboratory operations to ensure adherence to FDA, EMA, and global regulatory standards. Includes ~ 15%+ spent “on the floor” providing guidance and oversight.
* Review and approve batch records and supporting documentation to support timely and compliant batch disposition and product release.
* Lead and oversee the management of quality events, including deviations, investigations, CAPA, and change controls to ensure effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Maintain hands-on leadership and subject matter expertise in GMP quality operations, ensuring effective implementation and continuous improvement of the QMS.
* Provide quality oversight for qualification and validation activities, including process validation, equipment qualification, and validation lifecycle management.
* Oversee site GMP documentation review and approval.
* Partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Validation, and Regulatory teams to drive quality operations, inspection readiness, and continuous process improvement.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals, fostering a strong culture of GMP compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement. Lead direct reports through annual goal setting, growth planning, adherence to company policies, maintain training compliance and provide ongoing feedback on growth, development and areas of improvement.
 

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* Typically requires Bachelor’s degree in a core scientific discipline with 8+ years of overall work experience, including 3+ years in Biotech Manufacturing / Quality and 3+ years people management experience
* Familiarity with large molecule drug substance GMP manufacturing and testing
* Knowledge of current USP/Ph. Eur./FDA/ISO/GMP standards and guidance
* Ability to work independently or in team environments under deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to closely follow quality standards and company quality expectations
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills
* Strategic thinking combined with excellence in execution
* Ability to learn quickly, driven by high curiosity

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Denali offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k, healthcare coverage, ESPP and a broad range of other benefits. Learn more at https://www.denalitherapeutics.com/careers

This compensation and benefits information is based on Denali’s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Denali is committed to its core company value of unity by creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, basis of disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

records.title: Senior Manager - Biomanufacturing, Manufacturing Technical Operations
records.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Madison, Wisconsin site is a state‑of‑the‑art biologics development and manufacturing facility supporting customers from research through early‑ and mid‑stage clinical production. Located at 726 Heartland Trail in Madison, the approximately 102,700‑square‑foot GMP facility specializes in mammalian cell line engineering, drug substance biomanufacturing, and biopharmaceutical development, utilizing flexible single‑use systems to enable rapid scale‑up and customization. The site is home to Catalent’s proprietary GPEx® and GPEx® Lightning technologies, which are used to generate high‑yielding mammalian cell lines for biologic therapies, and supports production scales ranging from 50 to 4,000 liters for clinical manufacturing. Following a $45 million expansion announced in 2025, the Madison site has significantly increased capacity, added new equipment, and created approximately 200 highly skilled biohealth jobs, further strengthening its role within Catalent’s global biologics network and Wisconsin’s growing life sciences ecosystem.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager - Biomanufacturing, Manufacturing Technical Operations to join our team. This role leads the Manufacturing Technical Operations organization, including Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Compliance, Deviation Investigation, and Manufacturing Training. The position ensures safe, compliant, and reliable biomanufacturing operations while driving continuous improvement and technical excellence. The successful candidate will help strengthen workforce capability, reduce operational risk, and ensure sustainable preventive solutions across manufacturing operations.

Shift: Monday - Friday 8:00AM - 5:00PM 
Location: Madison, WI 
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Lead, coach, develop, and evaluate leaders and technical professionals supporting Manufacturing Engineering, Compliance, Deviation Investigation, and Training.
* Establish clear goals, role accountabilities, performance expectations, succession plans, and development strategies for the organization.
* Provide organizational ownership for Manufacturing-based engineering support and technical response to process, equipment, materials, automation, documentation, and execution issues.
* Establish and govern a structured Rapid Response Team process that defines the problem, operational impact, containment, technical resources, decision ownership, recovery plan, communications, and escalation pathway.
* Provide leadership and oversight for Manufacturing deviation investigations, including investigation quality, aging, cycle time, right-first-time approval, and recurring-event reduction.
* Ensure investigations are fact-based and clearly distinguish event description, product and process impact, root cause, contributing factors, correction, corrective action, and preventive action.
* Establish Manufacturing Technical Operations as a key owner and contributor to process readiness, including batch production record review, dry runs, equipment readiness, material availability, qualification status, and execution-risk review.
* Ensure new equipment is transitioned into routine use with defined operational ownership, procedures, training, spare parts, maintenance, and troubleshooting strategies.
* Establish an integrated performance-management system using measures such as recurrence, recovery time, repeat failures, downtime, deviation aging, investigation right-first-time performance, corrective and preventive action aging and effectiveness, qualification progress, equipment reliability, open risks, and project delivery.
* Use performance data to establish priorities, allocate resources, escalate risk, and hold leaders accountable for outcomes.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline required.
* Ten (10) or more years of relevant manufacturing, engineering, technical operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Quality, or related experience.
* Five (5) or more years of progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for technical professionals, people leaders, or manufacturing-support organizations.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical problem solving and operational recovery in a Good Manufacturing Practice manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience with deviation investigations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, root-cause analysis, inspection readiness, and quality risk management.
* Advanced understanding of current Good Manufacturing Practice biopharmaceutical manufacturing, including upstream, downstream, solution-preparation, equipment, and support systems.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as Next Generation Global Leaders, GOLD, LEAD Now, General Manager Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Advanced degree preferred.
* Experience in Good Manufacturing Practice biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

**Why You Should Join Catalent**
--------------------------------

* Defined career path and annual performance review and feedback process.
* Diverse, inclusive culture.
* Potential for career growth on an expanding team within an organization dedicated to preserving and bettering lives.
* Competitive paid time off plus 8 paid holidays.
* Community engagement and green initiatives.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment.
* Tuition reimbursement.

**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

personal initiative. dynamic pace. meaningful work.

Visit Catalent Careers to explore career opportunities.

Catalent is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, you may submit your request by sending an email, and confirming your request for an accommodation and include the job number, title and location to DisabilityAccommodations@catalent.com. This option is reserved for individuals who require accommodation due to a disability. Information received will be processed by a U.S. Catalent employee and then routed to a local recruiter who will provide assistance to ensure appropriate consideration in the application or hiring process.

Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives: Catalent Pharma Solutions (Catalent) is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting. Resumes submitted to any Catalent employee by a third party agency and/or search firm without a valid written & signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Catalent. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired for this position as a result of an unsolicited agency or search firm referral. Thank you.

Important Security Notice to U.S. Job Seekers:

Catalent NEVER asks candidates to provide any type of payment, bank details, photocopies of identification, social security number or other highly sensitive personal information during the offer process, and we NEVER do so via email or social media. If you receive any such request, DO NOT respond— it is a fraudulent request. Please forward such requests to spam@catalent.com for us to investigate with local authorities.

California Job Seekers can find our California Job Applicant Notice HERE.

**Volunteer Work Disclosure:** Applicants for employment in Massachusetts may include in their employment history any verified work performed on a volunteer basis.

**Massachusetts Lie Detector Test Notice:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law may be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Consistent with Massachusetts law, Catalent does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment.

records.title: Quality Engineering Sr Manager - L6
records.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Manages those who apply quality principles in the areas of: design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation, program performance, reliability, inventory control, and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality for make and/or buy products. Performs technical evaluations including product requirements, specifications, models/designs, drawings and procedures. Collaborates with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and customers on quality related issues to ensure quality standards are in place. Engages in product failure investigations, material review board decisions and corrective/preventive action. Ensures corrective measures meet acceptable reliability standards and/or are compliant with requirements. Develops strategies and systems designed to improve internal and/or supplier performance and productivity. Evaluates quality systems for deficiency identification and correction. Designs and analyzes inspection and testing processes, mechanisms and equipment; conducts product quality tests, performs statistical analysis to assess products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications. Engages in supplier selection process and maintain certification programs.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

records.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/our-company/careers/#Total-RewardsResponsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

records.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As production grows, we need clear evidence that each spacecraft meets its requirements and a quality system that helps teams find and resolve risks early.

We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Quality Operations** to lead US quality for satellite buses and payloads from incoming material through building, test and acceptance. You will build a pragmatic system and lead engineers and inspectors close to the floor. You have independent authority to hold work or withhold readiness concurrence and to escalate unresolved mission risk. This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead US quality engineers and inspectors across supplier, receiving, production and test coverage. Set training, inspection points and delegated authority.
* Own fit-for-stage quality controls for document and configuration records, serial and lot traceability, calibration, nonconformances, corrective action and acceptance packages.
* Define risk-based controls for critical characteristics and supplier parts. Work with Supply Chain on qualifications, escapes, containment and verified corrective action.
* Make quality status visible through yield, repeat defects, escapes, NCR aging and acceptance-record completeness. Use trends to improve controls with Manufacturing and Engineering.
* Own the quality hold and escalation process. Engineering owns technical disposition; Quality evaluates controls and evidence and concurs on release.
* Concur independently on quality evidence at acceptance and flight readiness reviews. Escalate residual risk despite schedule pressure; partner with Engineering on reliability and mission risk.
* Align common requirements with the Canada Quality Lead and feed ground defects and on-orbit anomalies into later builds.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 8+ years in quality engineering or quality management for aerospace, defense or similarly complex hardware, including 3+ years directly leading engineers, inspectors or specialists through production and test.
* Experience building a usable QMS and leading teams through supplier escapes, nonconformances, root cause and corrective action.
* Independent judgment, strong technical communication and the ability to separate Engineering disposition from Quality release concurrence.
* Working knowledge of configuration control, risk-based inspection, process capability and cross-functional investigations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, materials science, physics or a related technical field, or equivalent quality leadership experience in complex hardware.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K
