records.title: Senior Manager, Quality and Safety
records.description:
Site: Wentworth-Douglass Hospital

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

The Senior Manager, Quality and Safety is responsible for leading the local execution of Mass General Brigham Community Division strategy, infrastructure, processes, and performance improvement efforts across patient safety, risk management, quality, and clinical compliance. This role oversees and supports the implementation of standardized best practices, safety and quality programs, regulatory readiness activities, and performance improvement initiatives that advance safe, reliable, high-quality care. 
 
The Senior Manager serves as a key local administrative leader and partners closely with system and site leadership, clinical teams, the local ACMO, risk/safety leaders, infection prevention, compliance, legal, data and analytics teams, and other stakeholders to execute both short- and long-term goals for Quality, Patient Safety, Risk Management, and Clinical Compliance programs. 
 
This position is responsible for translating system strategy into local execution while also providing strong bidirectional communication between the site and system teams regarding local risks, emerging trends, operational needs, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities. 
 
Because this is a leadership role in an active change-management environment, the Senior Manager must demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and openness as the scope and needs of the role continue to evolve over time. 
 
Essential Functions 
 
Quality, Safety, and Risk Strategy Execution 
 

* Execute MGB Community Division strategy for patient safety, risk management, quality, and clinical compliance at the local site, ensuring alignment with standardized system processes, priorities, policies, and performance expectations.

 

* Support the buildout of local safety, quality, risk, and compliance infrastructure, including standardization in training, workflows, governance, reporting structures, and response processes that are in line with MGB.

 

* Collaborate with system and site leadership to execute long- and short-term goals for Quality, Patient Safety, Risk Management, and Clinical Compliance programs.

 

* Provide essential input to MGB leadership regarding strategy, infrastructure, policy development, performance improvement plans, and local operational needs to support high-quality care delivery.

 
Patient Safety and Risk Management 
 

* Execute MGB patient safety plans, including safety event reporting, event analysis, mitigation planning, and follow-up on safety-related concerns.

 

* Implement standardized risk management strategies, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities align with and strengthen the organization’s approach to patient safety.

 

* Implement and support use of the systemwide safety event reporting system.

 

* Support systemwide and local safety events, including recalls, shortages, and other issues that may impact patient safety.

 

* Partner with site Risk/Safety/PFR leaders and clinical teams to develop prospective solutions and performance improvement actions in response to safety events.

 

* Leads the development and delivery of patient safety and risk management training using culture‑of‑safety data, safety event trends, and systemwide priorities to promote continuous improvement, staff engagement, and safe, reliable care practices across all departments.

 

* Completes, within three (3) months of hire, High Reliability Organization (HRO) training, including Level 3, Fact Gatherer, and Process Facilitator, and integrates HRO principles into oversight of safety event analysis, improvement strategy, and organizational learning.

 
Quality Performance and Improvement 
 

* Serve as the local administrative leader responsible for executing quality performance and improvement programs at the site.

 

* Ensure adherence to MGB standardized processes for quality measurement, prioritized quality goals, quality strategy, and performance improvement activities.

 

* Provide proactive and reactive quality performance improvement planning in partnership with local clinical teams, department leaders, and floor-based teams.

 

* Lead the planning, implementation, and evaluation of process changes and performance improvement activities.

 

* Effectively communicate goals, strategic priorities, accountability expectations, and improvement plans to clinicians and operational leaders, engaging them as partners in achieving quality and safety outcomes.

 

* Serve as the senior local site manager responsible for Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) planning, documentation, and updates for board quality committee and/or patient care assessment committee needs.

 
Clinical Compliance and Regulatory Readiness 
 

* Serve as the senior local administrative manager responsible for clinical compliance activities, including tracer activity, site preparedness, monitoring, and adherence to standardized compliance processes.

 

* Build and support the local implementation of the MGB clinical compliance program, ensuring standardized processes, staff training, procedures, and governance are in place.

 

* Monitor institutional compliance with Joint Commission standards and other applicable regulations, and advise system leadership regarding areas requiring improvement.

 

* Lead or support proactive and reactive clinical compliance activities, including risk assessments, improvement plans, regulatory interpretation, and implementation of needed process changes.

 

* Serve as the senior clinical compliance manager responsible for management and performance during expected and unexpected regulatory visits, including but not limited to The Joint Commission, DPH, DMH, and CMS.

 

* Oversee submission of required documentation and reports to relevant accrediting and regulatory bodies, including DPH, DMH, TJC, BORIM, and MedSUN, and complete submissions directly when front-line support is not available.

 

* Liaise with system and site teams, clinicians, corporate compliance, and the Office of General Counsel regarding compliance issues, regulatory requirements, site visits, and areas of overlap.

 
Data, Analytics, Reporting, and Dashboards 
 

* Partner with MGB data and analytics teams to ensure reporting to CMS, other regulatory bodies, private payer contracting entities, external benchmarking organizations, and quality/safety reporting programs is timely and accurate.

 

* Understand data provided by system teams and use knowledge of local practices and culture to identify opportunities for improvement, emerging risks, and areas requiring local or system-level attention.

 

* Advise in the development of local and system-level dashboards related to quality performance, clinical compliance, patient safety, and improvement priorities.

 

* Analyze trends and emerging risks, communicate findings to local teams and system leaders, and support improvement planning based on available data.

 

* Prepare reports and presentations as needed for site leadership, system leadership, regulatory bodies, committees, and other stakeholders.

 
Collaboration and Local Leadership 
 

* Partner with the local ACMO and clinical teams to implement system goals, site-level improvements, and accountability processes.

 

* Liaise with infection prevention and control teams to monitor performance, respond to data, and support actions to reduce risk of infections to patients.

 

* Maintain strong organizational relationships and work effectively within a matrixed healthcare environment.

 

* Provide strong bidirectional communication between the system and site, including distribution of pertinent data, analytics, priorities, concerns, and operational feedback.

 

* Ensure recommended improvements are implemented and partner with local leadership to support accountability.

 
Staff Management and Department Operations 
 

* Manage, supervise, and support assigned quality, safety, risk, and/or compliance staff, including recruitment, interviewing, training, orientation, remediation, and performance evaluation.

 

* Establish development plans for staff and support ongoing professional growth, role clarity, and accountability.

 

* Manage departmental operations and budget responsibilities as assigned, including fiscal planning and budgetary recommendations.

 

* Oversee local training and educational programs related to quality, safety, risk, and clinical compliance as needed.

 

* Perform all other duties as assigned and requested.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required or Bachelor's Degree Patient Safety Leadership required and Master's Degree Nursing preferred 

 

**Experience**

 

* 3-5 years of safety, risk management, and patient family relations experience required.
* 3-5 years of experience leading process improvement and initiatives and managing teams required.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed healthcare organization preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

 

* Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB.
* Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation.
* Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety.
* Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system.
* Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety.
* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.

**Additional Job Details (if applicable)**

**Remote Type**

Hybrid

**Work Location**

789 Central Avenue

**Pay Range**

$99,465.60 - $144,643.20/Annual

**Grade**

8 
At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package.

**EEO Statement:**

1810 Wentworth-Douglass Hospital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857)-282-7642.

**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework**
---------------------------------------------

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations
records.description:
Location: On-site – Alachua, Florida (Greater Gainesville Metropolitan Area) 
Department: Quality Assurance 
Reports To: Head of Global Quality 
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site

### **About Ascend Advanced Therapies**

Ascend Advanced Therapies is a biotechnology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of advanced therapies, with a focus on adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies. Our team is committed to advancing innovative treatments through scientific expertise, operational excellence, and a strong culture of quality and compliance.

#### **About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Operations to join our team at our Alachua, Florida facility.

In this leadership role, you will oversee Quality Assurance activities supporting GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and related operations. You will provide strategic oversight of quality processes, ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness, and drive continuous improvement across site operations.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive Quality Assurance experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, demonstrated people leadership capabilities, and strong knowledge of GMP requirements, investigations, CAPAs, change control, and quality risk management.

This is a full-time, on-site leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional who is passionate about developing high-performing teams, strengthening operational excellence, and supporting the advancement of innovative therapies.

#### **Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Lead Quality Assurance support for GMP manufacturing, Quality Control, warehouse, facilities, and support operations.
* Establish departmental priorities and ensure quality activities support production schedules, client commitments, and regulatory requirements.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Provide strategic oversight of batch record review, room release, on-floor QA activities, manufacturing investigations, and product disposition support.
* Ensure appropriate QA oversight of Quality Control operations, including analytical data review, laboratory investigations, Environmental Monitoring, and data integrity compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant manufacturing and laboratory compliance issues.
* Oversee investigations, deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk management activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and compliance trends to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure inspection readiness through effective management of quality systems and compliance programs.
* Lead Quality participation during regulatory inspections, client audits, and corporate audits.
* Serve as the primary Quality representative during client interactions and compliance-related discussions.
* Review and approve responses to audit observations and regulatory commitments.
* Directly supervise and develop Quality Assurance personnel, including Senior Quality Operations Specialists.
* Establish performance objectives, provide coaching, and support employee development.
* Build team capability through mentoring, training, and succession planning.
* Provide independent, risk-based quality leadership across site operations.
* Balance business objectives with regulatory compliance requirements.
* Drive resolution of complex quality and compliance challenges.
* Influence cross-functional decision-making through technical expertise and sound judgment.
* Escalate significant compliance risks to senior leadership as appropriate.

#### **Educational Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 8-10 years of Quality Assurance experience within biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, vaccine, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Minimum 3 years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience, including performance management, employee development, talent management, succession planning, and employee engagement.
* Demonstrated experience supporting GMP manufacturing and Quality Control operations.
* Experience managing investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and quality risk assessments.
* Experience participating in or hosting FDA, client, and regulatory inspections.
* Strong technical knowledge of:

* + 21 CFR Parts 210, 211, 600, and 610
 + EU GMP Volume 4
 + Annex 1
 + ICH Q7, Q9, and Q10
 + FDA Data Integrity Guidance
 + FDA Process Validation Guidance
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects/tasks at one time, as well as management of program interdependencies to meet set timelines.

Preferred:

* Commercial biologics manufacturing experience.
* CDMO experience supporting multiple client programs.
* Experience supporting technology transfer and process validation activities.
* ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
* Experience utilizing electronic Quality Management Systems (MasterControl, Veeva, TrackWise, or equivalent).

#### **Physical Requirements**

This position requires the ability to perform duties in a combination of office and GMP-regulated manufacturing environments. Physical activities may include prolonged sitting or standing, walking throughout manufacturing and laboratory areas, reaching, bending, and performing repetitive motions associated with computer work and documentation review.

The role requires manual dexterity for typing and handling documents and materials, as well as visual acuity sufficient to review records, analyze data, read equipment labels, and distinguish colors.

Occasional lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling of materials may be required as appropriate to the position.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

#### **Travel Requirements**

Approximately 10%.

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position has direct supervisory responsibilities for Quality Assurance personnel, including performance management, coaching, employee development, and succession planning.

A minimum of three years of progressive people leadership and supervisory experience is required.

postedPay.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations

records.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The **Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations** is a highly visible leadership role within the Member & Client Services Engineering (MCSE) organization at CVS Health. This position is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and operational excellence of business-critical platforms that support millions of members, customer service operations, clinical services, and enterprise applications. In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, observability, incident management, and operational automation across a complex technology ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and managed service providers to deliver highly reliable, scalable, and resilient technology solutions that support CVS Health's mission.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with experience driving reliability engineering practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in large-scale enterprise environments. You will play a key role in advancing modern SRE capabilities, including AI-driven operations (AIOps), observability, automation, and proactive service reliability initiatives. As a people leader, you will build and develop high-performing teams, influence strategic technology decisions, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. This role requires a passion for solving complex operational challenges, improving customer experiences, and driving measurable business outcomes through technology excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Leadershi**p**
* Execute and advance the enterprise SRE strategy, including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and reliability roadmaps.
* Establish reliability standards and best practices across applications, APIs, data platforms, and emerging AI-powered solutions.
* Champion a culture of reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
* Drive platform resiliency, scalability, performance, and risk mitigation initiatives.

**AI-Driven Operations (AIOps) & Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AIOps capabilities to improve proactive issue detection, predictive analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Implement AI-assisted incident management, automated remediation, self-healing capabilities, and standardized operational runbooks.
* Partner with AI and platform engineering teams to integrate machine learning and generative AI technologies into operational workflows.

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Define and lead the enterprise observability strategy across metrics, logs, traces, and user experience monitoring.
* Drive standardization and adoption of observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Deliver actionable insights, dashboards, and executive reporting related to platform health, availability, performance, and reliability metrics.

**Incident Management & Operational Excellence**

* Lead enterprise incident response, escalation management, and post-incident reviews.
* Reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Restore (MTTR), and recurring incidents through automation and preventive engineering practices.
* Establish operational readiness standards, on-call processes, and service management best practices.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, and long-term service stability initiatives.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead high-performing global SRE and operations teams.
* Develop career growth frameworks, skill development programs, and technical leadership capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Partner with stakeholders across technology and business organizations to align reliability priorities with business objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* 10+ or more years of production support or service delivery experience.
* Experience working with a managed services vendor.
* ITIL Qualified & Expert knowledge of ITIL disciplines.
* Experience of managing 3rd parties and 3rd party delivered services.
* Service Management or Support in a large-scale and diverse environment of incident management, escalation procedures and related disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* High degree of self-motivation to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment.
* Strong communication skills are required to facilitate meetings with both technical and business audiences, often across multiple functional departments.
* Demonstrated understanding of various technologies (Java/J2EE, .Net, MQ, Mainframe, Telephony systems etc.)
* Experience with major database management systems, e.g. DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience creatively debugging complex system problems spanning entire hosting stack (application, server, communication channels, networking components, etc), resulting in problem determination and restoration through thorough research and fact finding.
* Be able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.
* Experience supporting both proprietary and vendor developed or supported applications.
* Demonstrated successful completion of technical projects.
* Demonstrated proficiency working on all phases of SDLC.
* Able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* ITIL certified

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$106,605.00 - $213,210.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/30/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

records.title: Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

records.title: Senior Director of Operations
records.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 
 
Compensation: $201,500.00 - $277,000.00

records.title: Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering
records.description:
**Continue to Grow with GXO.**

At GXO, we know our greatest asset is people like you - energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. Your career matters to us because your passion and excitement will help keep our company moving forward.

 

As the **Senior Manager, Industrial Engineering**, you will lead the development of facility layouts and designs, labor standards, staffing and efficiency analyses, and identify cost-saving opportunities while supporting operational implementations.

**Pay, benefits and more.**

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you’ll do on a typical day:**

* Hire, train and develop industrial engineering staff; provide technical support and direction to site industrial engineers and managers
* Develop labor standards, process flow diagrams and job descriptions for new and existing operations
* Conduct time study analyses to estimate facility staffing requirements and establish production standards
* Identify, evaluate and implement productivity improvements
* Document processes to facilitate operational startups and provide on-site support as required
* Convert contract documents and SOWs into work instructions and operating procedures
* Analyze ongoing costs and compare them to prior cost and pricing estimates
* Select appropriate models for receiving, put-away, picking and packing solutions
* Identify storage and picking strategies based on product dimensions and activity levels
* Identify facility design requirements based on activity levels, product envelopes, product flow, transportation methods, building layout and power requirements
* Specify material handling and storage equipment solutions, including automation where justified
* Collaborate with IT resources to develop equipment requirements based on activity levels

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

At a minimum, you’ll need:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 5+ years of experience working in a warehouse, distribution or 3PL environment
* Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Experience with Labor Management Systems (LMS)
* Project management experience, including leading projects from concept through completion

records.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

postedPay.title: Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production

records.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Manager, Global Visual Merchandising Production will lead the strategic planning, creative execution, and global production of visual merchandising activations across the Michael Kors retail network. This role is responsible for delivering innovative, brand-elevating experiences that drive customer engagement while ensuring operational excellence, fiscal responsibility, and flawless execution worldwide.

 

Working closely with Global Visual Experience, Store Design, Marketing, Creative Services, Supply Chain, and regional partners, the Senior Manager will oversee the end-to-end production lifecycle for seasonal campaigns, retail environments, windows, in-store experiences, and new store openings. This role will also lead vendor strategy, production innovation, and team development to support the continued growth of the brand globally.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and lead the global production strategy for all Visual Merchandising assets, while providing direct leadership and oversight for the North America region, ensuring alignment with brand, business, and market objectives.
* Own the performance and evolution of the global production function, including operating models, production capabilities, quality standards, vendor networks, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish scalable production processes, governance, and resource strategies that support current business priorities and future growth across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
* Serve as the strategic advisor to Visual Merchandising, Design, and Creative teams, influencing decisions related to feasibility, engineering, materials, fabrication, innovation, and investment priorities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance speed-to-market, scalability, sustainability, quality, and cost efficiency while maintaining brand integrity.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Visual Merchandising production process globally.

**Global Production Management**

* Lead the end-to-end production lifecycle for all global Visual Merchandising programs, including windows, props, visual tools, branded environments, animations, and special activations.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, fabrication, logistics, installation, and execution across retail, outlet, wholesale, and special project channels.
* Ensure all programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and brand consistency.
* Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing competing priorities, business needs, and market requirements.
* Proactively identify executional risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery across regions and stakeholders.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Own global production budget planning, forecasting, capital investment recommendations, and overall financial performance.
* Develop cost optimization strategies and scalable sourcing models that improve efficiency without compromising quality, customer experience, or brand standards.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships with fabricators, printers, logistics providers, installation partners, and other key vendors worldwide.
* Establish vendor performance metrics, accountability measures, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure best-in-class execution.
* Evaluate production investments, operating models, and resource requirements, providing recommendations based on business impact, risk, and return on investment.

**Executive Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the senior production partner to Visual Merchandising, Store Design, Marketing, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional leadership teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, business acumen, and a comprehensive understanding of brand, customer, operational, and financial priorities.
* Build alignment across functions and regions while balancing competing priorities to achieve the best overall business outcome.
* Represent the production function in senior leadership discussions, ensuring production considerations are incorporated into broader business planning.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and drive adoption of new processes, technologies, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness globally.

**Team & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing production team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability by developing future leaders, strengthening succession plans, and creating scalable ways of working.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and development plans that enable increasing levels of ownership and autonomy across the team.
* Allocate resources strategically to ensure effective execution across a complex portfolio of global initiatives.
Create an environment where proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and enterprise leadership are expected at all levels. 

 

**You’ll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production Management, Design, Construction Management or a related field.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive experience in visual production, retail marketing production, environmental design, experiential production, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing teams in a global environment.
* Proven success leading large-scale, multi-market production programs within a premium or luxury retail organization.
* Strong expertise in project management, fabrication, print production, logistics, and installation processes.
Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and complex vendor ecosystems. 

 

**We’d Love to See:**

* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate creative vision into operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen.
* Highly collaborative with experience working across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, project management platforms, and collaborative workplace tools.

—

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, military status, disability, genetic information or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

At Capri Holdings Limited, we are committed to providing a fair and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation for the interview or application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at CapriTalentAcquisition@CapriHoldings.com.

In compliance with certain Pay Transparency laws, employers are required to disclose a compensation range. The range for this position will vary based on role requirements, skill set, and years of experience. Please note that for salaried roles, the figures reflect full-time equivalency, while for hourly roles, the figures represent the applicable hourly rate.

Compensation Range:

140,000.00 - 150,000.00 USD

records.title: Senior Manager - Data Center Operations
records.description:
**About Us** 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 12-03-2026

**Job Description**

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Data Center IT Operations is a first-line people leader responsible for the safe, reliable, and disciplined execution of Data Center IT Operations across enterprise data center environments. The role oversees teams supporting day-to-day data center operations, mainframe physical infrastructure activities, and storage and tape/media operations while ensuring work is completed to approved scope, service commitments, security requirements, and operational standards.

This position translates Director-level strategy and priorities into daily operating plans, clear accountability, effective staffing, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution. The role provides direct people leadership, operational governance, technical escalation, change and incident oversight, vendor coordination, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the supported functions.

The Senior Manager is a working people leader. The role is expected to maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge plans, validate readiness, guide escalations, and make risk-based operating decisions, while relying on senior technical contributors and subject-matter experts for detailed engineering authority and platform-specific design decisions.

The Senior Manager collaborates with capacity planning, facilities, DCIM, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders by providing accurate operational data, site constraints, implementation demand, lifecycle information, and risk inputs needed for forecasting and investment decisions.

Proficiency

 

* Leadership Proficiency: Experienced first-line manager capable of leading 24x7 operational teams, senior technical contributors, and cross-functional delivery in a regulated, highly available environment.
* Technical Proficiency: Broad working knowledge across data center IT operations, hardware lifecycle execution, mainframe physical operations, enterprise storage, and tape/media handling, with the judgment to engage the correct engineering authority for specialized decisions.
* Operating Scope: Accountable for team performance, daily service execution, risk management, workforce readiness, controls, and stakeholder communication across assigned sites or operating functions.

Supported Organization and Role Alignment

The role is designed to provide direct people leadership and operational accountability for the following job families or equivalent roles, subject to the final organization design:

* **Data Center Operations Analysts and Senior Analysts:** 24x7 on-site operational coverage; change implementation; rack-and-stack; migration, turn-up, decommission, incident, remote-hands, inventory, documentation, and site-readiness activities.
* **Senior and Senior Consultant Data Center Engineers:** Advanced execution, small-project or process ownership, work-team guidance, technical escalation, documentation quality, operational improvement, and mentoring within the assigned job function.
* **Staff Data Center Engineers or Technical Leads:** Senior individual contributors providing change governance, complex escalation support, cross-site standards, process design, technical strategy input, and first-among-equals workload coordination without formal personnel-management authority.
* **Mainframe Operations Support Personnel:** Physical installation and lifecycle support, cabling and connectivity coordination, hardware change readiness, incident response, vendor activity, console or access coordination where applicable, documentation, and escalation to mainframe engineering teams.
* **Storage and Tape/Media Operations Personnel:** Physical storage infrastructure support, tape library and media operational activities, secure media handling and chain-of-custody controls, inventory reconciliation, vendor coordination, incident and change support, and escalation to storage or backup engineering teams.

Final direct-report assignments should be confirmed through the approved organization design. This profile establishes the management scope and accountabilities expected if these roles report to the Senior Manager.

Core Responsibilities

People Leadership and Workforce Management

* **Direct People Management:** Lead, coach, and develop direct reports through clear goals, regular feedback, performance management, development planning, recognition, and accountability.
* **Staffing and Coverage:** Maintain staffing and schedule coverage appropriate to business demand, including 24x7 operations where assigned. Manage timecards, attendance, leave coordination, required training, on-call participation, and escalation coverage in accordance with policy.
* **Talent and Succession:** Partner with recruiting and leadership to fill vacancies, onboard employees, build bench strength, identify successors, reduce single points of knowledge, and create development opportunities across operations, mainframe, and storage/tape disciplines.
* **Role Clarity:** Define decision rights, work expectations, handoffs, escalation paths, and ownership boundaries among people leaders, Staff engineers, Senior Consultants, Senior engineers, Analysts, vendors, and partner teams.
* **Team Culture:** Foster a culture of safety, service, inclusion, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and respectful challenge.

Data Center IT Operations Management

* **Daily Operations:** Oversee day-to-day execution of changes, installations, rack-and-stack work, migrations, turn-ups, decommissions, break/fix activity, incident response, remote-hands requests, inventory support, and site-readiness work.
* **Work Prioritization:** Translate business priorities into executable daily and weekly plans. Balance urgency, customer impact, technical risk, available skills, approved change windows, service commitments, and staffing capacity.
* **Operational Handoffs:** Ensure shift turnover, open-work tracking, escalation notes, customer commitments, incident status, and incomplete activities are communicated accurately and acted upon.
* **Site Stewardship:** Maintain operational ownership for non-facilities data center areas within scope, including organization, housekeeping, staging, tools, test equipment, spares, consumables, labeling, access readiness, and visitor or vendor coordination.
* **Service Continuity:** Ensure the team can sustain critical operations during staffing shortages, severe weather, major incidents, business-continuity events, or other disruptions, using approved contingency and escalation procedures.

Mainframe, Storage, and Tape/Media Oversight

* **Mainframe Operations:** Provide people leadership and operational oversight for physical mainframe activities, including implementation readiness, installation and deinstallation support, connectivity and cabling coordination, incident support, vendor access, documentation, and escalation to platform engineering.
* **Storage Operations:** Oversee operational support for enterprise storage hardware and related physical infrastructure, including approved changes, hardware lifecycle events, break/fix coordination, cabling, inventory, documentation, and vendor engagement.
* **Tape and Media Operations:** Ensure tape library and removable-media activities follow approved procedures for handling, tracking, movement, storage, reconciliation, retention, destruction coordination, and chain of custody.
* **Technical Authority Boundaries:** Ensure platform design, configuration authority, architecture, and specialized engineering decisions remain with designated engineering owners. The Senior Manager is accountable for operational execution, readiness, controls, and escalation.
* **Lifecycle Coordination:** Coordinate lifecycle demand, maintenance windows, end-of-life risks, spares, vendor support, and implementation dependencies with Hardware Asset Management, engineering, procurement, security, and service owners.

**Change, Incident, Problem, and Escalation Governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* **Change Governance:** Ensure assigned changes are reviewed for scope, approvals, implementation and backout plans, access, staffing, materials, dependencies, risk controls, customer communication, and validation evidence before execution.
* **Incident Leadership:** Lead or support operational response for high-severity or complex incidents, establishing clear ownership, timely escalation, evidence-based communication, recovery validation, and follow-through.
* **Problem Management:** Use recurring incidents, failed changes, defects, rework, control exceptions, and customer feedback to drive root-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive controls, and sustained remediation.
* **Decision and Escalation:** Make timely decisions within delegated authority and escalate when business impact, safety, security, compliance, architecture, funding, or cross-organizational tradeoffs exceed the role’s authority.
* **After-Hours Leadership:** Participate in the established leadership escalation model and ensure appropriate technical and management support is available for critical events outside standard business hours.

Controls, Security, Safety, and Audit Readiness

* **Control Execution:** Ensure operational procedures support company policies, regulatory obligations, security requirements, change controls, asset controls, media controls, and documented evidence expectations.
* **Safety and Stop-Work:** Promote safe work practices and ensure employees or contractors pause and escalate work when unsafe conditions, unauthorized activity, inadequate controls, or material quality risks are identified.
* **Physical Security:** Enforce access, escort, visitor, vendor, material-movement, and restricted-area requirements. Escalate access anomalies and security concerns promptly.
* **Audit Readiness:** Maintain accurate records, evidence, inventories, reconciliations, procedures, training completion, corrective actions, and control-owner responses needed to support audits and risk reviews.
* **Media Governance:** Ensure secure media handling, inventory accuracy, chain of custody, retention and destruction coordination, exception management, and evidence quality for tape and other removable media within scope.

Operational Standards, Documentation, and Data Quality

* **Standardization:** Implement and reinforce consistent operating standards across shifts, sites, and supported platforms while allowing documented local variations where required.
* **Procedures and Runbooks:** Ensure SOPs, runbooks, checklists, escalation guides, implementation instructions, and training materials are current, usable, controlled, and understood by the team.
* **Systems of Record:** Ensure timely and accurate updates to approved ticketing, DCIM, CMDB, Hardware Asset Management, inventory, media, and operational reporting systems.
* **Data Quality:** Establish ownership for correcting discrepancies in asset records, rack elevations, device locations, cable records, inventory, media records, work notes, and completion evidence.
* **Knowledge Resilience:** Reduce dependence on individual subject-matter experts through cross-training, documented procedures, mentoring, simulations, and structured knowledge transfer.

Vendor, Partner, and Stakeholder Management

* **Vendor and Contractor Oversight:** Confirm scope, access, safety expectations, schedules, tools, materials, deliverables, evidence, and escalation paths for vendors, contractors, customer engineers, and service partners.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Build effective working relationships with facilities, network, mainframe, storage, backup, security, Hardware Asset Management, DCIM, capacity planning, change management, incident management, procurement, finance, and business service owners.
* **Customer Communication:** Provide concise, risk-based communication on service status, delivery commitments, blockers, operational impacts, decisions, and corrective actions.
* **Leadership Representation:** Represent the operational perspective in planning forums, change reviews, incident calls, audit discussions, project reviews, and leadership meetings, escalating strategic or funding decisions to the Director.

**Metrics, Financial Stewardship, and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Measures:** Define and monitor measures such as change success, on-time completion, failed changes, rework, incident response, repeat incidents, backlog age, throughput, service-level attainment, inventory accuracy, media-control accuracy, documentation quality, audit findings, and corrective-action closure.
* **Performance Management:** Use data to identify trends, clarify accountability, prioritize improvements, and coach the team. Measures should support better decisions and sustained service improvement.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead initiatives that reduce manual effort, eliminate recurring failure modes, strengthen controls, improve workflow efficiency, and increase predictable service delivery.
* **Financial Stewardship:** Manage assigned operating expenses, tools, training, vendor usage, overtime, spares, and discretionary spending within delegated authority. Identify cost avoidance and efficiency opportunities without compromising safety, security, resilience, or control effectiveness.
* **Benefits Validation:** Set measurable outcomes for improvement initiatives and verify that adopted changes deliver the intended operational, risk, quality, or financial benefit.

Capacity Planning Collaboration, Not Ownership

* **Role Boundary:** The Senior Manager does not own enterprise capacity strategy, forecasting models, white-space planning, power and cooling forecasts, or capital capacity decisions.
* **Operational Inputs:** Provide accurate demand signals, rack and floor observations, deployment schedules, lifecycle events, backlog, staffing constraints, inventory needs, and implementation risks to the teams accountable for capacity planning.
* **Plan Review:** Participate in capacity reviews to validate operational feasibility, implementation sequencing, site readiness, resource requirements, and delivery risk.
* **Constraint Escalation:** Identify and escalate operational constraints involving space, power, cooling, cabling, access, staffing, tools, spares, or schedule conflicts to the accountable owner.

*This is an on-site position. An on-site position must be consistently performed at an assigned Visa office location and require daily commute to the office location*

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

 

* 8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

 

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* 5+ years of direct people-leadership experience, including performance management, coaching, staffing, talent development, and accountability for operational outcomes.•
* Experience leading 24x7 data center operations teams and managing shift-based coverage models.
* Experience in financial services or another highly regulated, audit-intensive, high-availability environment.
* Experience with DCIM, CMDB, Hardware Asset Management, media-management, inventory, change-management, incident-management, ticketing, and workflow systems.
* + Experience supporting IBM Z or comparable mainframe physical operations, enterprise storage platforms, tape libraries, and secure removable-media processes.
* Experience establishing operational metrics, dashboards, control evidence, corrective-action programs, and data-driven improvement plans.
* Experience managing vendor performance, operational budgets, training investments, overtime, tools, spares, and service contracts.
* Relevant industry certifications in data center operations, IT service management, project management, infrastructure, security, storage, mainframe, or safety are beneficial.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure operations, mainframe operations, enterprise storage, backup/tape operations, hardware lifecycle management, or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading teams in a production, highly available, regulated, or geographically distributed data center environment.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing change execution, incident response, problem management, vendor activity, operational controls, documentation, and service-level commitments.
* Broad working knowledge of data center physical infrastructure, including rack-and-stack practices, structured cabling, fiber and copper connectivity, labeling, power dependencies, equipment handling, inventory, and asset lifecycle processes.
* Working familiarity with mainframe physical environments, enterprise storage infrastructure, and tape/media operational controls, with the judgment to engage specialist engineering teams when required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across engineering, facilities, security, asset management, service management, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive escalation, risk communication, performance reporting, and operational decision documentation.
* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation support and work safely within a physical data center environment in accordance with applicable procedures.

**Information for US Applicants**

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $143,700.00 to $ 229,500.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

**Work Hours**

Varies upon the needs of the department.

**Travel Requirements**

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

**Mental/Physical Requirements**

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

records.title: Senior Manager - Process Engineering - Walker, MI Plant
records.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement
